verdict.rationale: Drive supports background automation mainly through developer building blocks. Push notifications tell your app whenever a watched resource changes, the developer docs list automation use cases (creating files from Form submissions, bulk modification, audit spreadsheets), and there is a path to build an AI agent add-on with ADK and Vertex AI Agent Engine. All of this means writing and hosting your own code or add-ons rather than configuring automations in the product. Missing for 10: a native no-code automation or rule builder inside Drive, documented scheduled or trigger-based execution managed by Drive itself, evidence of autonomous agent runs in the background, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
